providers.note: Gemini's only Bedrock-mapping guide (ai-gemini-to-bedrock.md) lives under skills/gcp-to-aws/references/design-refs/, scoped to that one skill's adapter. It is not a shared, cross-skill guide under skills/shared/ai/ the way anthropic's and openai's guides are, so this provider does not clear the bar for status: supported.

gateways.note: status: unknown reflects documentation coverage only, not code: discover-openrouter-api.md already detects OpenRouter usage and BYOK-vs-credits attribution per upstream model at runtime. What is missing is a shared, cross-skill mapping GUIDE (the ai-anthropic-to-bedrock.md / ai-openai-to-bedrock.md equivalent) that documents how an OpenRouter-fronted upstream model maps onto a Bedrock target. Until that guide exists, this entry stays unknown rather than supported, per this catalog's rule that a mapping-guide document is the bar for supported and an implemented adapter/route is a separate, stricter bar tracked by implemented_adapter.
